## What's Changed

- Fix that setting `completionPolicy.ttlSecondsAfterFinished` to clean up nodeimage data would also delete the job itself. Now expose the `default-ttlseconds-for-always-nodeimage` cli param for kruise-controller-manager to control the nodeimage data ttl instead by @bitsf in #2219

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/compare/v1.8.4...v1.8.5
